senses.gloss: break of day, light, day; fire; trnsf. rise, glory, power, happiness.
units: Ber. 2ᵇ ביאת אוֹרוֹ the entrance of his day-break (dawn of his eighth day; Tosaf. a. l. the sunset of his seventh day).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 1:1:3">Y. Pes. I, beg. 27ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ החמה</he> sun-light.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 1:1:3">Ib.</cite> <he>א׳ הנר</he> candle light.
<cite ref="Ketubot 111b:5">Keth. 111ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ תורה</he> light of the Law.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 4a:3">B. Bath. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>אוֹרוֹ של עולם</he> intellectual light of the wold (a great man; the Law).
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 15:19">Num. R. s. 15</cite> <he>אור של מעלן</he> the celestial fire (believed to be the source of all light and fire); a. v. fr.

<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 1:1">Pes. I, 1</cite> <he>לארבעה וכ׳ א׳</he> on the evening (eve) of the fourteenth day of Nissan; v. discussion <cite ref="Pesachim 2a:8">ibid. 2ᵃ</cite> sq., about the meaning of our w.

<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 22b">R. Hash. 22ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 70b:10">Snh. 70ᵇ</cite> <he>לא׳ עיבורו</he> the evening following the eventual intercalation, i.e. the evening from the thirtieth of the past to the first of the beginning month.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20:12">Gen. R. s. 20</cite> in the Pentat. of R. M. it read <he>כתנות אור וכ׳</he> (in place of <he>עור</he> <cite ref="Genesis 3:21">Gen. III, 21</cite>) this alludes to the garments of Adam resembling the rue, wide below and narrow above; Ar. (Rashi diff.).
